figures.shows: Greyscale HST, Spitzer and Gemini optical/infrared images of the field of HE 0515-4414 overlaid with red ALMA contours, labelling the quasar, companion sources A1-A6 and wind components C1 and C2, and the SZ decrement with a putative outflow cone in the uv-tapered panel.

axes.quantity: ALMA continuum flux density (naturally weighted, and uv-tapered in right panels)

figures.validation_check: Shows the SZ decrement location relative to the quasar and optical/infrared wind emission, and the ALMA sources removed as point sources, as a spatial check of the detection.
readable_values: approx. naturally weighted contour levels -7, 7, 14, 28, 56 and 128 µJy
approx. uv-tapered contour levels -20, -10, 10, 20 µJy (-3, -1.5, 1.5, 3 sigma)
figures.caption_quote: Greyscale images of the ﬁeld of HE 0515-4414 with ALMA contours superposed in red.
